name: ci-security
summary: Supply-chain checks for a project on GitHub: workflow lint (actionlint, zizmor), Dependency Review, pnpm audit, OpenSSF Scorecard, a Dockerfile check, a security policy, and Dependabot or Renovate.

options.dependabot: Dependabot opens the update pull requests. Nothing to install.
options.renovate: Renovate opens them instead. A person installs its GitHub App on the repository first.
